Firebase Auth error-code string tokens — token group.
Source src/core/tokens/strings/auth.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

AUTH_BLOCKED_STORAGE_CODES

Codes whose root cause is blocked third-party site data — the firebaseapp.com auth iframe can't store/read the OAuth event. The login view uses this set to show the "allow site data" guidance instead of the authorized-domains copy.

AUTH_REDIRECT_FALLBACK_CODES

Codes where the popup handshake cannot run in the current browser environment (popup blockers, COOP window.closed blocking, partitioned storage, unsupported contexts) — these retry via signInWithRedirect. User-cancellation codes are deliberately excluded.

AUTH_DOMAIN_DEFAULT

The project's default Firebase authDomain — hosts the /__/auth/* helper (popup handler + storage-relay iframe). Used whenever the app itself can't serve the helper same-origin (http dev, non-https hosts).

AUTH_SELF_HOSTS

Hosts that serve /__/auth/* themselves — Firebase Hosting exposes the auth helper on every connected domain, so when the app runs on one of these over https the authDomain can point at the app's own host. That makes the helper iframe same-ORIGIN: its web-storage event relay stops being third-party data and survives the partitioning/blocking that silently kills the firebaseapp.com relay. NOTE: www.luiskr.com is deliberately absent — the host doesn't resolve.

AUTH_URLS

Auth endpoint URLs — the Identity Toolkit REST surface. createAuthUri is the read-only call the __/auth/handler page makes to build the provider URL; the diagnostic probe re-issues it after an opaque auth/internal-error to recover the real server-side rejection reason (the SDK rebuilds relayed event errors by code only and drops the nested message).
